goal: ASP.NET middleware review: ordering, short-circuiting, exception handling and headers.
use: ASP.NET middleware review: ordering, short-circuiting, exception handling and headers. Use when the request pipeline is changed.

steps.note: List the middleware in the order it runs.
Check ordering. Authentication must run before authorisation, and both before the endpoints.
Check exception handling. It must run early enough to catch the rest.
Check headers. Security headers are set for every response.
Report. The pipeline order, the gap found and the fix.
